web_fixture.title: Queue settings - Saltmarsh reference
web_fixture.snippet: Standard queues use a 90-second visibility timeout by default; batch queues are documented separately.
web_fixture.content:
# Queue settings

Saltmarsh reference, reviewed 2026-05-20.

Standard queues hand a message to one worker at a time. A message that a worker
has received but not deleted becomes visible to other workers again after the
visibility timeout, which defaults to 90 seconds for standard queues and can be
raised per queue up to 43200 seconds.

Other defaults for standard queues:

* max_message_bytes - 262144
* delivery_attempts - 5, after which the message moves to the dead-letter queue

A worker that finishes early deletes the message and frees the next slot
immediately.

web_fixture.title: Batch queue settings - Saltmarsh reference
web_fixture.snippet: Batch queues deliver up to 100 messages at once and default to a 600-second visibility timeout.
web_fixture.content:
# Batch queue settings

Saltmarsh reference, reviewed 2026-05-20.

Batch queues deliver up to 100 messages in one response and give the whole
batch a single visibility window. The visibility timeout for batch queues
defaults to 600 seconds and can be raised per queue up to 43200 seconds.

Batch queues keep the same delivery_attempts default of 5 as standard queues.

turns.prompt: Our order workers read from a Saltmarsh standard queue and leave the visibility timeout unset. How many seconds does a worker have after receiving a message before that message can be handed to another worker? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
